description: Country artist Trey Taylor is playing a full live set to help send Sarah Mertens to the Illinois State Senate — and you're invited. The end of the campaign is no time to slow down, and your contribution helps us get to election day with a strong finish! One night can fund weeks of this campaign.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Citizens for Sarah Mertens
title: An Evening with Trey Taylor and Sarah Mertens — Citizens for Sarah Mertens
